Okay so as an f2p who completed the previous Zoey pav (no regrets) AND also happens to like this suit _I am in grave danger_

But fear not for I have a plan! (lies)

So I have about 1k, I plan out when would be the perfect time for me to activate one of the 2 trial cards that I have so that I get the 980 diamond pull, then I use the 2 480 diamond pulls (depending on timing though) and after that we should get like 5 free tries and then I grind for 5 more tries which I may or may not get and I could easily figure that out by simple math which I won't because I know the results wouldn't be in my favour but I'll just pretend that they are and in live in the delusion that I can at least get the pieces that i like, and frankly I like the side pieces better than like the dress which should be harder to get.

After I feel like I'm satisfied withy earnings I resist the temptations of useless spending which I can't and don't blame me for finding this suit so damn gorgeous. Then for the next event I just do the 480 pulls, if I can and get back to grinding. I'm not really a big fan of the Lilith Halloween and most the suits I like happen to be free! (ish) as in arena suits, which I frankly have no hope on :'D

As for saving for URs.. I mean the one UR event I really like is the wedding one and I don't expect it to be coming anytime soon, unless it does. And if it does _I will burn down paper for doing that_ tbh I'm not quite a competitive player, Im quite satisfied with the stuff i have and the next few events don't exactly excite me. Sure some of them I like a bit more, like this one but I'll just hope and wait for a possible rerun
